English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #factual In the last four years, 32 69 258 Sri Lankans have left the country. Factual The annual report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka reveals that 32 69 258 Sri Lankans have gone abroad in the last 4 years from January 2020 to December 2023. by Anonymous | May 3, 2024 Accordingly, 3,14,659 Sri Lankans have gone abroad in 2020 and 3,09,234 have left the country in 2021. The figures for 2022 and 2023 are 12,07,758 and 14,37,607, respectively, for the number of individuals who left the country. According to the Central Bank report, the highest number of people went abroad between 2020 and 2023. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase? The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
